stories.title: Traffic homicide detectives investigate fatal Lakeland crash where man died after slamming into tree
stories.summary: A 44-year-old man died after his truck crashed into an oak tree and burst into flames. The Polk County Sheriff's Office is investigating the high-speed incident.

stories.title: Man dead after shooting in Riverview; deputies investigating
stories.summary: Deputies responded to a call about the shooting on Pradera Reserve Boulevard, where they say they found the man with at least one gunshot wound to the upper body.

stories.title: From planning a wedding to a funeral: Family of bride-to-be killed in Courtney Campbell crash calls for change
stories.summary: The accused driver had a previous DUI conviction and was released from jail just four days before the deadly crash, court records show.

stories.title: Tampa Bay ranks third nationally for road-related vehicle repairs, Pep Boys report finds
stories.summary: As millions travel for Thanksgiving, a new report ranks Tampa Bay among the worst for road-related vehicle repairs.

stories.title: Driver accused of striking, killing pedestrian pushing shopping cart arrested in St. Pete
stories.summary: Police say 21-year-old Cauiau "CJ" Davis-McKinney is charged with leaving the scene of a crash involving death.

stories.title: Hernando County detention deputy suspended after investigation into relationship with former inmate
stories.summary: The sheriff's office says the deputy claimed he knew the woman before she was jailed, but she disputed that.

stories.title: USPS launches holiday mailbox decorating program in Tampa
stories.summary: As the winter season rounds the corner, the U.S. Postal Service wants to join in on the holiday spirit.

stories.title: Bradenton man pleads guilty to Home Depot wire fraud scheme
stories.summary: Prosecutors say the man stole nearly $150,000 over the course of a year.

stories.title: New dengue cases appear to slow across Tampa Bay: See latest county-by-county numbers
stories.summary: Florida has confirmed 669 locally acquired cases of dengue fever, but health officials say there have been fewer cases reported this week.

stories.title: Convicted felon charged with strangulation death of pit bull: Hillsborough deputies
stories.summary: Victor Tisdell is accused of strangling his neighbor's 2-year-old pit bull to death.

stories.title: Deputies search for man accused of stealing identical train sets from 2 Hobby Lobby stores
stories.summary: Surveillance video shows the suspect wearing the same outfit, but different pairs of glasses, during each theft.

stories.title: 3 arrested after gunfire damages car, apartment buildings: Hillsborough deputies
stories.summary: Detectives say they found evidence tied to the shooting during a search of a home where the suspects were found.
